question: Who among the following became the king of Magadha after killing his father, Bimbisara?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ajatashatru**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Ajatashatru** became the king of Magadha after killing his father, Bimbisara. 
 
• His expansion of the kingdom and annexation of the kingdom of **Anga** to the east is considered to have laid the foundations for the later expansion of the Mauryan empire.
